prohibited_inferences: Do not treat the v14 extension or PC-16 fixture as evidence that any named organization is liable, insured, in breach, negligent, solvent, or obligated to pay.
Do not infer complete loss allocation from technical recovery, public correction, an indemnity, a policy, or a customer payment.
Do not infer direct affected-party standing from an indemnity or insurance policy running only among organizations.
Do not infer payment from contract language, policy existence, claim submission, acceptance, judgment, settlement, or correction alone.
Do not infer complete affected-party compensation from a liability cap, partial settlement, technical recovery, or institution-level reimbursement.
Do not infer correct cross-organizational allocation or remedy durability from complete affected-party compensation.
Do not infer timely enforceable remedy from the existence of a forum, arbitration clause, appeal, regulator, or public fund.
Do not infer breach, negligence, causation, misconduct, manipulation, or intent from uncompensated or externalized loss alone.
Do not infer public authorization from standing, compensation, settlement, insurance, correction, or technical recovery.
Do not treat the sixteen-control floor as exhaustive of every legal, economic, constitutional, security, social, or performative failure mode.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A compositional successor floor that preserves the qualified fifteen-control v13 base and adds PC-16 federated liability loss allocation insurance standing payment enforcement and public-remedy equifinality without rewriting the frozen base controls.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A legal opinion liability finding insurance-coverage determination damages award public-authorization verdict named-organization allegation or complete universal theory of remedy and loss allocation.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: Preference Custody floor v14 composes the qualified v13 controls with PC-16. It separates technical recovery from indemnity insurance standing adjudication payment affected-party compensation cross-organizational allocation enforcement delay residual loss and remedy durability, while requiring real cases to preserve complete entity contract law loss causation payment succession and authority custody.
